name_note: Genomes GTDB places in Faecalimonas are also deposited under the names Coprococcus and Tyzzerella, reflecting recent reclassifications.

sentences.text: Faecalimonas was proposed as a new genus for obligately anaerobic, Gram-positive cocco-bacilli of the family Lachnospiraceae isolated from human faeces.
Faecalimonas umbilicata, the species for which the genus was named, is described as an acetate-producing bacterium whose genome carries genes for acetate and vitamin B12 synthesis.
A later study concluded that Clostridium nexile belongs in Faecalimonas, proposing the name Faecalimonas nexilis, and reclassified Coprococcus mobilis as Faecalimonas mobilis.

A later study proposing reclassifications added further species to the genus: Faecalimonas mobilis, and Faecalimonas hominis for strain OB7656T, isolated from faecal samples of healthy Japanese volunteers.
